from solution import get_maxgold
import inspect


def test_issue_example_from_issue():
    """Issue example asserts 4x4 mine yields 16."""
    assert get_maxgold([[1, 3, 1, 5], [2, 2, 4, 1], [5, 0, 2, 3], [0, 6, 1, 2]], 4, 4) == 16  # 5+2+4+5 = 16


def test_issue_single_cell():
    """Gold mine problem with 1x1 mine yields its cell."""
    assert get_maxgold([[7]], 1, 1) == 7  # 7 = 7


def test_issue_single_row():
    """Gold mine problem with one row sums straight right."""
    assert get_maxgold([[1, 2, 3, 4]], 1, 4) == 10  # 1+2+3+4 = 10


def test_issue_single_column():
    """Gold mine problem with one column picks best start row."""
    assert get_maxgold([[4], [2], [9]], 3, 1) == 9  # max(4,2,9) = 9


def test_issue_best_start_row():
    """Gold mine problem must start from best row, not top row."""
    assert get_maxgold([[1, 100], [100, 1]], 2, 2) == 200  # max(1+100, 100+100) = 200


def test_issue_two_by_three():
    """Gold mine problem finds optimum in 2x3 mine."""
    assert get_maxgold([[1, 3, 3], [2, 1, 4]], 2, 3) == 9  # 2+3+4 = 9


def test_issue_middle_gold():
    """Gold mine problem reaches middle gold from either side row."""
    assert get_maxgold([[0, 0, 0], [0, 5, 0], [0, 0, 0]], 3, 3) == 5  # 0+5+0 = 5


def test_issue_all_zeros():
    """Gold mine problem with all zeros yields zero."""
    assert get_maxgold([[0, 0], [0, 0]], 2, 2) == 0  # 0+0 = 0


def test_issue_diagonal_path():
    """Gold mine problem optimum uses diagonal moves."""
    assert get_maxgold([[1, 1, 100], [10, 1, 1], [1, 10, 1]], 3, 3) == 111  # 10+1+100 = 111


def test_issue_rectangular_three_by_four():
    """Gold mine problem solves rectangular 3x4 mine."""
    assert get_maxgold([[1, 3, 1, 5], [2, 2, 4, 1], [5, 0, 2, 3]], 3, 4) == 16  # 5+2+4+5 = 16


def test_contract_signature():
    """Public interface requires get_maxgold(gold, m, n)."""
    assert len(inspect.signature(get_maxgold).parameters) == 3  # 3 params = 3


def test_contract_returns_int():
    """Gold mine total is an integer sum."""
    result = get_maxgold([[1]], 1, 1)  # 1 = 1
    assert isinstance(result, int)
